name: pharmacovigilance-icsr-narrative
title: 药物警戒 ICSR 叙述起草者
description: Use this skill when a drug-safety processor, PV scientist, QPPV, or MAH safety team needs to draft an ICH E2D / GVP Module VI–aligned ICSR narrative for a single adverse-event case. Validates case criteria, computes reportability clocks, and produces a DRAFT narrative packet for safety-physician / QPPV review before submission.
